e3.model_revision: exact local file hashes required in the run lock
e3.score: cosine of CLIP projected image and text embeddings, official model preprocessing

target_texts.T1-B: A photograph of a Singapore hawker meal with clearly visible cooked broccoli added to the rice or noodles.
target_texts.T2: A photograph of a Singapore hawker meal with light brown wholegrain rice.

e3.tie_rule: first maximum in archived seed_tags order

e4.pixel_rule: Only existing binary-mask pixels: HSV H=30deg, S=0.35, V=0.82*original V. Round RGB half-up to uint8. No resizing, feathering or per-image tuning.
e4.interpretation: Chromatic-shortcut stress control. Acceptance is not a false acceptance without the same output's blinded human failure label.

source_policy: read-only; new output directory; no paid API; no model download
